title: Which centre serves each UAT, in one consolidation scenario
description: The frozen provider for the transport engine's single input interface: a map from every UAT to the centre that serves it, produced by running the administrative simulator once at recorded parameters. The parameters travel with the map on purpose — a hub assignment means nothing without the scenario that produced it, and this simulator's argument is precisely that a consolidation saving administration adds travel.

scenario.description: The administrative model's parameters, as run. Recorded so the map cannot be quoted without them.

singletonHubs.description: Hubs serving only themselves. A feeder route to one of these has nothing to feed.

savingsRon.description: What the consolidation claims to save, carried from the administrative simulator so both columns of the ledger sit together.

hubOf.description: UAT SIRUTA -> serving centre SIRUTA. Every UAT appears exactly once.
